abstract_model_result.scope: ABSTRACT CONTRACT MODEL ONLY; NOT native, E2E, hardware qualification, stability, or activation evidence

tests.name: test_01_codec_roundtrip_retains_native_width_and_rejects_ambiguous_fields
tests.contract: Outer typed LP keeps 64-byte legacy IDs intact and rejects alternate fields.

tests.name: test_02_ticket_known_bytes_and_domain_network_policy_epoch_binding
tests.contract: Exact ticket bytes/endian and all contextual bindings are checked independently.

tests.name: test_03_threshold_inclusive_boundaries_and_integer_domain
tests.contract: Ticket equal to T passes; T+1 fails, including D limits and type rejection.

tests.name: test_04_complete_paid_pipeline_reaches_observed_difficulty_without_minting_rights
tests.contract: A real hash ticket drives acceptance, measured synthetic pressure, and D_5.

tests.name: test_05_trial_slot_blocks_result_route_model_target_and_nonce_rerolls
tests.contract: One funded slot binds the first result; aliases cannot buy another free seed.

tests.name: test_06_distinct_funded_slots_allow_legitimate_same_input_without_worldwide_dedup
tests.contract: Two paid opportunities for the same input remain legitimate independent trials.

tests.name: test_07_actual_capital_lock_and_preseal_fee_are_required_before_ticket
tests.contract: Insufficient funds and capital reuse fail without partial fees or slot state.

tests.name: test_08_global_preseal_budget_does_not_expand_for_models_or_principals
tests.contract: Nonzero per-preseal worst-case control reserves bound all identities together.

tests.name: test_09_freeze_seed_and_readiness_use_canonical_half_open_windows
tests.contract: Seed-after additions, changed anchors, second seeds and late material fail.

tests.name: test_10_seed_failure_stops_new_responsibility_and_no_free_next_seed
tests.contract: A missing designated seed disables its target without changing a protected claim.

tests.name: test_11_ineligible_never_decodes_heavy_material_or_calls_planner
tests.contract: An actual D_max ticket is rejected before heavy payload handling.

tests.name: test_12_missing_or_mismatched_material_is_not_qualified_congestion
tests.contract: Missing canonical readiness is terminal without forging NoCapacity.

tests.name: test_13_paid_false_commit_can_qualify_but_does_not_prove_computation
tests.contract: Residual paid manipulation is explicit: the gate cannot establish output truth.

tests.name: test_14_rank_is_independent_of_ingress_order_and_legal_batch_partition
tests.contract: Same closed set/canonical clock/service cut/external state gives partition-invariant results.

tests.name: test_15_prefix_skips_reorder_and_duplicate_batch_cannot_spend_twice
tests.contract: A native advance must visit the exact next prefix; replay returns one receipt.

tests.name: test_16_whole_batch_rolls_back_planner_exception_without_forged_congestion
tests.contract: Failure after an earlier candidate discards its funds/book/cursor/cost changes.

tests.name: test_17_dynamic_fit_uses_vectors_and_can_admit_multiple_small_candidates
tests.contract: No fixed count or winner: two small candidates fit while a large one fails intrinsically.

tests.name: test_18_valid_all_refused_candidates_still_create_known_congestion
tests.contract: A funded candidate fitting the empty residual book produces high on real conflict.

tests.name: test_19_invalid_qualification_funding_and_deadline_do_not_manufacture_high
tests.contract: High existing reservations do not turn disqualified candidates into valid demand.

tests.name: test_20_raw_invalid_ingress_never_changes_canonical_pressure_or_difficulty
tests.contract: RPC noise stays in finite local ingress; only authenticated canonical observations count.

tests.name: test_21_spent_work_and_peak_live_stock_survive_completion_before_boundary
tests.contract: Closed-epoch charges and stock peaks prevent a false low after actual release.

tests.name: test_22_released_unexecuted_future_peak_is_not_permanent_pressure
tests.contract: Only present obligations, actual cost/live peak, and recorded congestion survive.

tests.name: test_23_far_future_obligations_and_fixed_system_subtraction_are_observed
tests.contract: All bounded future intervals use C_A, preserving fixed system reservations.

tests.name: test_24_outer_one_bps_is_separate_from_copacked_payload_capacity
tests.contract: 120 outer permits do not subtract 120 from the residual inner payload dimension.

tests.name: test_25_zero_supply_and_book_overflow_stop_instead_of_clipping_or_easing
tests.contract: Positive unavailable supply or an overfull book is a stop signal, never wrapped low.

tests.name: test_26_incomplete_tail_prevents_low_but_preserves_valid_known_high
tests.contract: Incomplete coverage may increase D on sound evidence; it can never idle-decay.

tests.name: test_27_complete_empty_and_zero_eligible_epochs_allow_intended_idle_decay
tests.contract: Three complete low observations ease D; an explicitly missing service resets it.

tests.name: test_28_exact_controller_thresholds_rounding_and_unavailable_precedence
tests.contract: Independent boundary vectors cover 256/768, gains, clamps and priority.

tests.name: test_29_bootstrap_schedule_and_boundary_order_do_not_rewrite_frozen_difficulty
tests.contract: D_2 precedes collection; later boundaries publish only b+2 and reject gaps/replay.

tests.name: test_30_all_routes_use_the_gate_and_future_or_disabled_routes_default_deny
tests.contract: Every connected new responsibility requires the same funded preseal path.

tests.name: test_31_existing_remedies_are_exempt_but_original_expansion_is_not
tests.contract: New D, unavailable seed/profile and entry noise cannot revoke prior actor rights.

tests.name: test_32_failed_and_expired_trials_refund_once_without_free_reroll
tests.contract: Finite settlement conserves funds, preserves consumed slots, and does not slash.

tests.name: test_33_pruning_does_not_resurrect_a_used_trial
tests.contract: Compact highwater/nullifier state survives finite record retention.

tests.name: test_34_cancel_preserves_closed_set_paid_cost_and_finalized_observation
tests.contract: Cancellation does not erase a closed root, spent money or a previous congestion fact.

tests.name: test_35_canonical_snapshot_restores_schedule_cursor_funds_slots_and_book
tests.contract: Reorg restores one checkpoint; stale worker generations cannot mutate the new branch.

tests.name: test_36_missing_snapshot_is_local_hold_not_consensus_unavailability_vote
tests.contract: An incomplete local host abstains; it cannot manufacture controller observations.

tests.name: test_37_unknown_ten_thousand_and_fifty_thousand_model_ids_do_not_create_budget
tests.contract: Identifier invariance only: NOT a benchmark or a real registry/load test.

tests.name: test_38_detailed_quotes_cannot_bypass_eligibility_or_run_free_on_changed_basis
tests.contract: Cheap quote is header-only; detailed quote needs an eligible paid trial and cache key.

tests.name: test_39_batch_visit_cost_caps_apply_even_to_ineligible_or_rejected_records
tests.contract: Cheap failures cannot create zero-cost unbounded cursor visits.

tests.name: test_40_difficulty_never_overrides_hard_resource_capacity
tests.contract: All tickets can pass at D=1 without admitting an over-capacity original.

tests.name: test_41_seed_guard_cut_is_strict_and_late_seed_is_not_missing_material_fault
tests.contract: The designated seed must finalize after freeze and before cut, with guard remaining.

tests.name: test_42_policy_generation_and_capital_rollover_cannot_resurrect_original_opportunity
tests.contract: TrialUse keeps the underlying native opportunity across policy hashes and outpoint aliases.

tests.name: test_43_genuine_reorg_undoes_preseal_fees_and_slot_in_one_checkpoint
tests.contract: Canonical undo may remove a preseal; ordinary cancel/prune cannot imitate that undo.

tests.name: test_44_executed_flow_cannot_be_reused_within_the_same_epoch
tests.contract: Finishing and releasing a claim does not refund already-debited interval capacity.

tests.name: test_45_every_connected_route_reaches_the_same_actual_ticket_gate
tests.contract: Plain, funded, evaluation and batch originals all fail the same real D_max ticket.

tests.name: test_46_unsupported_or_zero_capacity_candidate_does_not_vote_global_unavailable
tests.contract: Candidate-local impossibility is rejected without forging an active-policy service fault.

assumptions: All costs, capacities, fees, timing fixtures and native reference bytes are synthetic, not measured values.
Native inner codecs/signature verification/capital provenance/common cost derivation are trusted fixture inputs.
Seed/closed/ready-root derivations prefixed TEST are deterministic test adapters, not allocated wire formats or beacon security proofs.
The reservation adapter aggregates bounded current/future vectors and stock; full RFC-0055 actor graph, ClockBridge and court planner are external.
Qualified demand is derived from candidate outcomes; output truth is deliberately not an admission input.
Local ingress and restoration readiness are excluded from canonical difficulty observations.
10,000/50,000 model-ID loops check identifier invariance only; no real registry/model/load benchmark was run.
not_verified: Native route integration, actual native inner codecs, signatures, DB/index/reorg implementation and production allocator.
Beacon unpredictability/bias resistance, real carrier service/inclusion/fairness and off-chain censorship.
Actual LLM/Panel/provider cold acquisition, full rerun, public court, Final, P_m and finite credit/right issuance.
Hardware performance, CPU/RAM/I/O/retention limits, hostile network throughput, 50,000-model registry/IBD scale.
Closed-loop stability, utilization/latency target achievement, actual sustained 1 BPS, deployment or activation.

limitations: A zero added-failure count does not turn pre-existing checker failures into passes.
The historical source and link-issue baselines were not updated.
Source provenance is recorded separately; abstract adapters are not native implementations.
No hardware sizing, 10k/50k real registry load, closed-loop stability, Studio-to-Final, or public 1 BPS performance claim follows from this result.
